info.title: API.SH: Vinted
info.description: The Vinted API from API.SH: public Vinted data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Vinted's category tree for a country site: every catalog (Women, Men, Kids, Home... down to the leaf categories) with its id, title, link, parent and depth. Pass `id` for one branch; use ids as catalog_ids with /vinted/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vinted-catalog

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: Use an id as catalog_ids with /vinted/v1/search

get.description:
One Vinted listing: title, description, brand, size, condition, color, upload time, price and currency, availability, category and breadcrumbs, favourites, photos, and the seller's public summary (username, feedback count and rating, badges, profile link). Pass the item link (its domain sets the site) or its id with `country`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vinted-item

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Vinted item link (any Vinted domain).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Vinted site for `id`: US (default), GB, FR, DE, ES, IT...

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: Levis jeans
example.description: Jeans levis come nuovi e impeccabili.

get.description:
Second-hand listings on Vinted for keywords and/or filters, on any of its 23 country sites (prices in local currency): sort (relevance, newest, price), price range, and brand, size, condition, color, material and catalog (category) ids as shown in Vinted links. Each item: id, title, brand, size, condition, price, buyer-protection fee and total price, favourites, seller id, link and photos. 96 per page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vinted-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `nike`. Required unless a filter is given.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Vinted site by country: US (default), GB, FR, DE, ES, IT, NL, BE, PL, AT, PT, IE, LT, CZ, SE, DK, FI, LU, SK, HU, RO, GR, HR.

parameters.name: status_ids
parameters.description: Condition ids, comma-separated (6 new with tags, 1 new without tags, 2 very good, 3 good, 4 satisfactory).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

items.title: Nike Modern 2010s Green and Black Graphic Hoodie

get.description:
A Vinted member's public profile: username, photo, about text, rating (out of 5), feedback counts (positive, neutral, negative), items for sale, items sold and bought, followers and following, business seller details, city and country, holiday mode, last seen, verification badges, bundle discounts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vinted-user

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Vinted member id (`seller_id` in search and item results).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Vinted member link (/member/<id>); its domain sets the country.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Vinted site for `id`: US (default), GB, FR, DE, ES, IT, NL, BE, PL, AT, PT, IE, LT, CZ, SE, DK, FI, LU, SK, HU, RO, GR, HR. A `url` sets it from its domain.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
